title: Early stages of wounded crown
author: Old_man_junky
selftext:
This was a about a month ago, I've redone down fonts, added better UI and done some balancing and added resolution options since then. 

Also added a pre-round parley system similar to the bust model of something like phoenix wright/fire emblem or most jrpgs. I'm In the process of doing voiceover and I still need to compose music for a few other parts of the game. But it's coming along, I've bought some more background art and tried lighten up and de-artifact most of the generated but ideally this is place holder art that will be changed later too.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
It looks pretty rough right now.

The interface should not be a set of buttons on the lower left side of the screen; that's going to feel extremely clunky. A context-sensitive menu right where the action is would feel much more responsive. 

The 'choose up to \[X\] units' screen is very bad. The player has no reasonable information to work with, and it would likely be overwhelming and awkward to manually dig into each unit, try to memorize what they do, etc.

Either give the player a pre-loaded set of characters (maybe one they can later edit once they've earned an unlock or whatever, demonstrating familiarity with the game), or multiple presets (again, probably unlockable). Telling the player to build a whole team before they have any context for how the game will work, what characters they might enjoy, etc, is hugely negative friction. 

  
The sprites do look incredibly clean; what was your workflow for creating them, out of curiosity? I've never been able to get sprites that clean looking from an LLM.

replies.author: Old_man_junky
replies.body:
This was a very early build. But yeah I agree with most of the critique. There is a training facility in the start menue now with tutorial or free play but free play only lets you use sprite models you've faced or used in the actual game and the encyclopedia unlocks a bio when met. I've changed it so hovering over an ability gives it a summary of the ability too so a player is not blind. 

There will be a pseudo opening scene for playing a fist time but this is more for scene setting than learning the game, if will start with a last stand battle with just a king Vs a boss team limited to 2-3 rounds. 

Still going through balance as I have 51 playable sprites so far 5 unique bosses and 10 monsters sprites which will never be user playable to add flavour and variation. 

It's coming along nice, il probably do another video next week with everything that's been updated 🫡

I use pixellabsai to generate sprites and movements, cost about £30 in generations

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body: Yeah, that makes sense... Pixel Lab and other specialized pixel art generators are so expensive. x.x

replies.author: Old_man_junky
replies.body: I think 30 is ok, I had plenty of generations left over, I was making a small endless runner game prior and wasted a lot on assets and messing around before I started taking it more serious 😅
